TSUAG Student Lands Fortune 500 Job, Aims to Combat World Hunger
After his May 2024 commencement ceremony, recent TSUAg graduate and Agricultural Science major Kerrington Howard took a position with Fortune 500 commodity trading firm Archer Daniels Midland, Where he aims to work on the issue of food insecurity.

A Degree For Every Dream
With two B.S. degree offering featuring 11 concentrations, an additional four M.S. degree programs, and a Ph.D. program an Agricultural Sciences, our degree structure focuses on real-world skill development, specialization and research.
Learn More
Academic Departments
These academic departments within TSU Agricultural Sciences offer diverse pathways in agriculture, environment, food systems, and human development. Together, they prepare students with hands-on experience, research opportunities, and industry-focused skills to support sustainable communities and modern agricultural innovation.
Agricultural Sciences and Engineering
Agricultural Business and Education
Food and Animal Sciences
Environmental Sciences

Discover Your Niche
Discover where your passion fits within the College of Agriculture through an inside look at our programs, people, and hands-on learning experiences. Watch the video to explore how each department helps students build real-world skills, engage in research, and find their place in agriculture, environmental science, food systems, and human sciences.
